rc01forgot0000a1.invariant: A miss is usually a FORGOTTEN-HOW-TO-FIND, not an absence. Before declaring 'not found', search what EXISTS: memory, rib_bus, steal docs, old conversations, the field corpus.

rc02gamelook0000b2.invariant: Use the GAME LOOK (game_world_map) to navigate: each kind of thing lives in a known place (memory -> World-Memory/verkle, instructions -> rib_bus, steals -> memory/steal, vendors -> field corpus). Look there first.

rc03stealrecov0000c3.invariant: STEAL to recover: search our own steal docs + repo memory + good-work RIBs before giving up. Local agents around the frontier do this through TOOL USE, not by asking the operator.

rc04honest000000d4.invariant: NEVER fabricate a hit or an absence. If the search genuinely finds nothing, report it as 'truly absent' — the mirror corrects false finds.

rc05quantized000e5.invariant: Quantized from frontier: this logic is compact on purpose — a dumb (local/flash) agent carries it without a frontier round-trip.
